editorial:
Imagine your favorite trickster rabbit finally finding a home with a sweet, gentle doctor who actually treats him with kindness. That is how things start for Bugs Bunny in this wild ride. You get to see a side of Bugs that is actually quite cozy, as he settles into a nice house with Dr. Jekyll. However, the vibe shifts fast once the doctor drinks a magic potion and turns into the mean and scary Mr. Hyde. It is a funny take on a classic scary story, blending slapstick humor with a bit of a spooky twist that keeps you guessing what will happen next.

The pacing is super fast, and the gags are timed perfectly, which is exactly what you want from a classic cartoon. You will love how Bugs handles the chaos with his usual cool attitude. While it is a short film, it packs a lot of punch. It is a perfect pick for a family movie night or if you just need a quick laugh.
endingExplained: The story wraps up with a chaotic chase where Bugs has to deal with the grumpy Mr. Hyde. In a funny twist, Bugs manages to outsmart the villain by using the doctor's own potions against him. After some wild running around and classic cartoon violence, the potion wears off or is reversed. Everything goes back to normal, and Bugs proves once again that no matter how scary the monster is, a clever rabbit always wins in the end.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves classic Looney Tunes and funny twists.
